newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel-based stocks lead Mauritius index up.
newsitem.headline: Hotel-based stocks lead Mauritius index up.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex gained 1.60 points to 391.50 on Wednesday after a surge in hotel stocks, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 14.29 million rupees on 398,702 shares from 23.80 million rupees on 564,238 shares on Monday.

Sun Resorts was a rupee higher to 50 rupees on 56,867 shares, Grand Baie Hotel rose 50 cents to 46 rupees on 40,420 shares and New Mauritius Hotels gained 20 cents to 36.20 rupees on 44,327 shares. The national carrier Air Mauritius climbed a rupee to 41 on 41,725 shares.
In the commerce sector, conglomerate Ireland Blyth Ltd gained 30 cents to 16 on 5,100 shares while Rogers lost two to 108 on 15,179 shares. Shell rose 20 cents to 20.30 rupees on 1,200 shares.
Among sugar stocks, Harel Freres rose two to 54 on 21,341 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert, after a share price surge last week, fell 20 cents to 41.80 rupees but was not traded.
In the banking sector, State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 13 on 127,600 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 89 rupees but was not traded.
Insurance-based Swan gained 10 cents to 45.80 rupees on 1,120 shares and British American Insurance was unchanged to 8.45 rupees on 2,950 shares.
